labelling: One labeller. Each label is the reading of the reply against its scenario rubric and the judge's standing instructions (no invented facts, no promise the agent cannot keep, no data it should not reveal). The 24 bad replies were written to fail; the 24 healthy-agent replies were read one by one. "ambiguous" marks labels a second reader could reasonably flip.
